description: This is a Kotlin source file defining an Android work manager worker class 'AstrologyUpdateWorker' responsible for updating astrology details by interacting with a database, repository, and astrology service.

classes.name: AstrologyUpdateWorker
classes.description: An Android worker class extending CoroutineWorker, designed to fetch and update astrology details for the current day.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Overrides the doWork method to execute the process of fetching astrology details and updating them in the repository. Returns a Result indicating success or failure.
